proposal.summary: A vulnerability in DNS functionality of Cisco Nexus Dashboard Software allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause a denial of service by sending a continuous stream of DNS requests that can stop the coredns service or cause the device to reload.

AV.quote: could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker

AC.quote: An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a continuous stream of DNS requests to an affected device.

PR.quote: could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker

C.quote: could allow the attacker to cause the coredns service to stop working or cause the device to reload, resulting in a DoS condition.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Collect vendor advisory or affected-version details and obtain exploit/reproduction steps and logs from an affected instance to confirm impact and scope.

evidence_quotes.quote: A vulnerability in the DNS functionality of Cisco Nexus Dashboard Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a denial of service (DoS) condition.
This vulnerability is due to the improper processing of DNS requests.
An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a continuous stream of DNS requests to an affected device.
A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the coredns service to stop working or cause the device to reload, resulting in a DoS condition.
